objective: V4.4 Context Orchestration and Chat Wire — token-budget packing, structured cognitive sections, and integrate sparks into live chat via build_prompt.
context: V4.0 build_cognitive_context serves API/Actions only. conversation_runtime._impl_build_prompt still calls retrieve_memories on legacy memory_items. V4.3 delivers bounded retrieval. V4.4 makes cognitive memory the primary chat context backbone with canon/docs authority preserved above it.
decisions: Cognitive block sits below filesystem canon and world truth in prompt order.
Legacy memory_items remain cold-start fallback only when active spark count below threshold.
Count limits become token-budget aware using conservative char/token estimates.
Output still passes spark_sanitize before model.
Structured sections are additive in /api/cognitive/context; preserve core_sparks/supporting_sparks until a later breaking-change release.
non_goals: Removing memory_items table or retrieve_memories API
UI redesign beyond optional debug confidence display
risks: Prompt token overflow if budget packer mis-estimates
Regression in chat quality when legacy path demoted
Double-counting context if both cognitive and legacy blocks appear
qa_expectations: Per ticket: tests/test_context_token_budget.py, tests/test_cognitive_context.py, tests/test_prompt_task_frame.py extensions. Chat API smoke at T5.
next_action: Do not claim until V4.3 T5 doc-locked.

approval.note: V4.4 chat wire is the critical path to cognitive backbone.

tickets.title: V4.4 T1: context token budget packer
tickets.description: Add context_token_budget.py estimating tokens/chars for spark rows and trimming ranked results to a configurable remaining-context budget (default chat allocation ~2000 tokens conservative). Trim lowest score first; pinned/high-confidence protected. Integrate at end of build_cognitive_context before sanitize. Files: context_token_budget.py, context_orchestration.py, tests/test_context_token_budget.py. Depends on V4.3 complete.
acceptance: pack_sparks_to_budget(items, budget_tokens) returns trimmed list
Packer accepts an explicit remaining budget from the caller and reports the estimate used
Trace reports budget_tokens, used_estimate, dropped_count
Pinned sparks survive trimming unless over single-item cap
Budget tests cover overflow and edge single giant spark

tickets.title: V4.4 T2: structured cognitive context sections
tickets.description: Restructure build_cognitive_context output into fixed sections: CurrentState, RelevantDecisions, RecentActivity, KeyConstraints. Map spark_type and lane into sections; attach patterns/constraints into KeyConstraints. Never return raw ranked list as the primary model payload; API sections are additive and existing core_sparks/supporting_sparks compatibility fields remain available. Files: context_orchestration.py, tests/test_cognitive_context.py. Depends on V4.4 T1.
acceptance: API response includes structured sections object
Existing core_sparks/supporting_sparks response fields remain compatible for API/Actions callers
decision sparks land in RelevantDecisions
observation/fact sparks land in RecentActivity or CurrentState per rules documented in module
Sanitized output preserves section boundaries
Cognitive context tests assert section presence

tickets.title: V4.4 T3: wire cognitive context into build_prompt
tickets.description: Update conversation_runtime._impl_build_prompt to call build_cognitive_context for active project query, format sections into a ## CognitiveMemory system block below canon/task frame/world context. Pass conversation depth/mode into context call. Files: conversation_runtime.py, context_orchestration.py, tests/test_prompt_task_frame.py, tests/test_chat_api.py. Depends on V4.4 T2.
acceptance: build_prompt includes CognitiveMemory section when sparks exist
Prompt order documented: personality, mode, knowledge, tickets, world, task frame, canon, cognitive, legacy fallback, tasks
Chat turn integration test proves cognitive block present
No duplicate legacy memory block when cognitive path succeeds

tickets.title: V4.4 T4: legacy memory fallback tiering
tickets.description: Demote retrieve_memories hybrid block to cold-start fallback only when active spark count below context_resolution threshold or cognitive context empty. Label legacy block clearly as fallback in prompt. Files: conversation_runtime.py, context_orchestration.py, context_resolution.py, tests/test_cognitive_context.py. Depends on V4.4 T3.
acceptance: Legacy memory block omitted when cognitive context non-empty
Fallback activates under cold-start threshold with explicit label
Cold-start integration test covers both paths
retrieve_memories API unchanged for external agents
